result = horizontal + vertical

result = result - Pos(leg_length_x/2, thickness/2, depth/2) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, depth)

for i in range(3):
    y_pos = mount_hole_offset + i * mount_hole_spacing
    result = result - Pos(thickness/2, y_pos, depth/2) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter/2, depth)

part = result
part.name = "L_Bracket"
export_step(part, "output.step")
